name: Zap Reviews Widget for Elementor
author: Ido Navarro

sections.description:
The Zap Reviews Widget for Elementor allows you to easily integrate Zap reviews and ratings into your WordPress website using Elementor page builder.

Features

  • Display Zap Reviews on any page
  • Show Zap Score independently
  • Support for multiple Zap verticals (מתחתנים, רסט, דפי זהב)
  • Dynamic field support for Customer ID
  • Easy toggle controls for reviews and score display

Supported Verticals

  • מתחתנים (Weddings)
  • רסט (Rest)
  • דפי זהב (Yellow Pages)

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • Elementor Page Builder
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Usage

  1. Edit a page with Elementor.
  2. Search for “Zap Reviews” in the widgets panel.
  3. Drag and drop the widget to your page.
  4. Enter your Zap Customer ID
  5. Select your vertical (Site ID)
  6. Choose whether to display reviews, score, or both
  7. Save and publish.

Additional Info

For support or feature requests, please use the plugin’s GitHub repository or WordPress.org support forums.

This plugin is not officially affiliated with Zap. All trademarks and registered trademarks are the property of their respective owners.

External Services

This plugin connects to zap.dbusiness.co to fetch and display review data. The service is required for the core functionality of displaying reviews.

Data Transmission

  • The plugin loads JavaScript files from zap.dbusiness.co to render reviews
  • Review data is fetched when the widget is displayed
  • No personal user data is transmitted to the service
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/zap-reviews directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and activated
  4. The widget will appear in your Elementor editor as “Zap Reviews Widget”
sections.faq:
Do I need a Zap account to use this plugin?

Yes, you need to have a valid Zap customer ID to display reviews and ratings

Can I display multiple instances on the same page?

Yes, you can add multiple widgets with different customer IDs or display settings.

Is this plugin compatible with the latest version of Elementor?

Yes, we maintain compatibility with the latest version of Elementor.

  • Toggle controls for display options
